fields: L4 Beijing / Chinese New Year (tricycle; Shichahai hutong → Chang'an Avenue → Summer Palace). Same item fields as L3 v3.1. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = Lantern Riddle Stand 灯谜摊 questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = Chang'an Avenue fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Seventeen-Arch Bridge final 十七孔桥终极题 (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 5 riddle-stand + 4 fork + 1 final = 10. Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Lantern riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'). Stems are deduped against all L1–L3 banks (all grades).

questions.q_zh: 北京城区地图上 1 厘米代表 500 米，两条胡同在图上相距 5 厘米，实际相距多少米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At noon it is -3 °C in Beijing. By midnight it is 7 °C colder. What is the midnight temperature in °C?
questions.q_zh: 北京中午 -3 °C，到半夜降低了 7 °C，半夜多少摄氏度？

questions.subject: beijing
questions.q_en: From the bridge, Flora looks back at the Long Corridor along the shore. Which statement about it is true?
questions.q_zh: Flora 在桥上回望岸边的长廊。关于长廊，哪句话是对的？
choices: It is made of ice every winter
It is about 7.28 km long with 27 sections
It is about 728 m long with 273 sections
choices_zh: 全长约 7.28 千米，共 27 间
全长约 728 米，共 273 间
questions.explain_en: The Long Corridor is 728 m long with 273 sections.
questions.explain_zh: 长廊全长 728 米，共 273 间。

questions.subject: spring_festival
questions.q_en: A gate near the bridge shows the first line 向阳门第春常在. Which second line completes the couplet?
questions.q_zh: 桥边一扇门上的上联是「向阳门第春常在」。哪一句是它的下联？
questions.explain_en: 向阳门第春常在 / 积善人家庆有余: seven characters each, ending oblique then level.
questions.explain_zh: 向阳门第春常在，积善人家庆有余；各七字，上仄下平。
questions.qtype_zh: 春联知识（对仗/平仄/横批）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At dawn on New Year's Day it is -8 °C on the Seventeen-Arch Bridge. By noon it warms by 10 °C. What is the noon temperature in °C?
questions.q_zh: 大年初一清晨十七孔桥上 -8 °C，到中午升高了 10 °C，中午多少摄氏度？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On a park map, 1 cm stands for 200 m. The path from the Long Corridor to the Seventeen-Arch Bridge is 4 cm on the map. How many metres is it really?
questions.q_zh: 公园地图上 1 厘米代表 200 米，从长廊到十七孔桥的路在图上长 4 厘米，实际是多少米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Last year 800 lanterns lit the Seventeen-Arch Bridge. This year there are 10% more. How many lanterns are there this year?
questions.q_zh: 去年十七孔桥上亮了 800 盏灯笼，今年多了 10%，今年有多少盏？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A boat ride to the Seventeen-Arch Bridge costs a 6-yuan fee plus 4 yuan per person. Flora's group pays 14 yuan. How many people are in the group?
questions.q_zh: 坐船到十七孔桥要付 6 元手续费，每人再付 4 元。Flora 一行共付了 14 元，一共几个人？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A sketch of the bridge's lantern arch is 3 cm wide and 5 cm tall. A similar banner copy is 6 cm wide. How tall is the banner in cm?
questions.q_zh: 桥上灯笼拱门的草图宽 3 厘米、高 5 厘米，放大成相似的横幅后宽 6 厘米，高是多少厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Over four evenings, Flora counts 9, 13, 18 and 12 lantern boats floating near the bridge. What is the mean number per evening?
questions.q_zh: 连续四个晚上，Flora 在桥边数到 9、13、18、12 只灯船，平均每晚几只？
